findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of environment variables for directory resolution
 * @description Detect reliance on environment variables that may be attacker-controlled
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/env-based-dirs
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-20
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode getenvCall
where
  getenvCall = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["getenv", "environ"]).getACall()
select getenvCall, "Use of environment variables when computing platform-specific directories. Review trust boundaries if used in security-sensitive context."
findings.hypothesis: Platformdirs may rely on environment variables like HOME or XDG_* which could be manipulated in some contexts; we want to see where env vars are read.
